reviewer: Codex root and independent UI/backend agents; named human review pending
scope: User module only; no admin, POM, SQL/schema, asset, wrapper or Word changes
observations: Cart POST identity filter +10 precedes CSRF +20; deferred wrong-role MVC preHandle precedes controller argument binding.
Each CartService write is READ_COMMITTED; CustomerWriteGuard locks and rechecks actor before any cart/product mapper access.
Only cart_item is written; SQL parameters are bound; user identity is obtained from server session, not submitted userId.
New item AUTO id is checked for generated-key return, initial version0; same SKU merges under user row lock.
Actual quantity changes use user/item/version conditional UPDATE and affected-row checks; version overflow rejects before DML.
Valid same-value quantity returns before availability/capacity checks, leaving state intact; version-MAX remove is allowed.
Missing item404, existing foreign item403; owner/version checks precede mutation; invalid items remain removable.
Badge uses exact COALESCE(SUM(quantity),0) by authenticated CUSTOMER user_id, without join/status/stock filtering.
Cart view recalculates current-price BigDecimal valid subtotal; invalid rows remain visible; checkout disabled and no checkout/order route added.
Failed reauthentication resets identity and previously constructed badge model together; direct error rendering resolves current customer.
Failed owned forms preserve submitted raw quantity/version and error anchors; foreign rows are never rendered.
No th:utext or frontend badge arithmetic; shared CSRF/image/layout fragments reused; CSS additions scoped to U03/U05.
limits: Static observations do not establish concurrent requests or injected-failure rollback. Real HTTP/database/browser coverage is recorded by attempt results.
